title: TelemetryEvent
description: Canonical cross-language event emitted by Python, Rust and C++ components. Version 1. Additive changes only within a major schema version; a breaking change requires a new $id path and a new schema_version value.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event, generated with a CSPRNG or a deterministic UUIDv5.

schema_version.description: Major version of this schema. '1' for all draft-2020-12 v1 events.

kind.description: Coarse category controlling routing and retention.

source.description: Component that produced the event, e.g. 'services.engine_registry'. Never a hostname or a file path.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant/organisation. Empty string for platform-level events.

correlation_id.description: Trace identifier linking related events across languages and services.

timestamp.description: UTC instant in RFC 3339 form, always ending in 'Z'. Local times and naive timestamps are invalid.

metadata.description: Additional non-sensitive context. Credential-like keys are rejected by the producer; this channel must never carry secret material.
